cl.x: Provide Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (August 2024, Version 01.03).
Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU is a workability-enhancing admixture for use in various concrete applications (slump-keeper).

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU can be used in conventional, high slump or Self-Compacting Concrete, in precast/prestressed or ready mix applications, or in any application where extended concrete plasticity without excessive retardation is required. Sika Visco-Flow®-21 AU does not extend slump life through slowing down the hydration process of cement. Besides the slump-retaining effect Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU also offers a minimal water reducing effect, resulting in a lower dosage rate for the primary water reducer in the concrete mix. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU can be used as a stand-alone admixture or in combination with other Sika concrete admixtures.

cl.l: Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU is a unique concrete admixture used to improve the workability and slump retention of fresh concrete. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU uses innovative polycarboxylate polymer technology, which can be used in various concrete applications whenever extended slump retention and concrete plasticity without set time delay is required. Use of Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU delivers the following benefits to a concrete producer:
s: Extended slump retention without excessive retardation.
No need for concrete re-tempering.
Better ability to optimize concrete mix designs resulting in cost savings.
Ability to adjust slump retention to match transport time and temperature.
No deleterious effect on concrete shrinkage.
Enhanced early and final strength.
Reduced rejection rates due to issues related to concrete re-tempering.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Product Information > Dispensing
cl.x: For maximum efficiency, add Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU directly to freshly mixed concrete in the concrete mixer after all batching water and water reducing admixture has been added. Sika ViscoFlow®-21 AU may also be dispensed into freshly mixed concrete in the agitator truck, at the concrete plant or at the job site. To optimize the slump retaining effect, Sika recommends that the combined materials should be mixed for 80-100 revolutions either in the concrete mixer or in the agitator truck.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
